Self-reported record (account's own scorekeeping, unverified): rolling 33-25 (57%) through Week 5, 'without a losing week'. Stamped instance (2026-10-15, tonight's crew chief Brad Rogers): favorites 30-19 ATS (61%) over the last 3 seasons; favorites drawing the majority of bets 18-6 ATS (75%); the account's Week 6 chart listed SEA@DEN bias 'Home Favorites' with no selection shown (NA).
